## Methodology

The poll was conducted by Morning Consult from May 21 to May 24, 2026 among a sample of 2,002 registered voters in the United States. The interviews were conducted online and the data were weighted to approximate a target sample of registered voters based on gender, race, age, children in household, educational attainment, marital status, home ownership, region, and 2024 presidential vote.
